summary: Swiggy can change its terms, services, and policies at any time, and you are responsible for checking for updates. You must provide accurate account information, keep your payment details secure, and remain responsible for any content you post. Swiggy is not responsible for menu pricing, order delivery delays, or third-party merchant liabilities once an order is delivered.

clauses.quote: We reserve the right to modify or change these Terms of Use and other Swiggy policies at any time by posting modified documents on the Platform.
clauses.explanation_en: The company can change the terms anytime without directly notifying you.
clauses.explanation_hi: Company bina seedhe notice ke kabhi bhi terms badal sakti hai.

clauses.quote: Your continued use of the Platform and the Services after any change is posted, constitutes your acceptance of the amended Terms of Use
clauses.explanation_en: Using the service automatically means you accept any new terms.
clauses.explanation_hi: Service use karte rehne ka matlab hai ki aap naye terms se sehmat hain.

clauses.explanation_hi: Platform bina kisi purane notice ke services kabhi bhi band kar sakta hai.

clauses.quote: you agree to grant us a non-exclusive, worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, sub-licensable ... right to exercise the copyright, publicity, database rights or any other rights you have in your Information

clauses.explanation_hi: Aap company ko apne data aur content ko use karne ka permanent free haq dete hain.

clauses.quote: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your Swiggy Account and your access to the Services (i) if any information provided during the registration process or thereafter proves to be inaccurate ... (ii) if it is believed that your actions may cause legal liability

clauses.quote: Buyer understands that Swiggy's (including Merchant's and PDP's) liability ends once Order has been delivered to him/her

clauses.explanation_hi: Order deliver hone ke baad company ki koi zimmedari nahi rehti.

clauses.quote: We expressly disclaim all liabilities that may arise as a consequence of any unauthorized use of your credit/debit card.
clauses.explanation_en: The platform refuses all liability if your card is used without authorization.
clauses.explanation_hi: Aapke card ke unauthorized use par company koi zimmedari nahi legi.

clauses.quote: Swiggy does not offer any refunds against goods or services already purchased from a Merchant or PDP through the Platform unless an error that is directly attributable to Swiggy has occurred

clauses.quote: Swiggy reserves the right to amend, withdraw, modify, convert, suspend, or discontinue any such promotional benefits at any time without prior notice.
clauses.explanation_en: Promotions and offers can be changed or canceled anytime without notice.
clauses.explanation_hi: Offers aur promotions ko bina notice ke kabhi bhi band kiya ja sakta hai.

clauses.quote: Swiggy will not be responsible for any delay in the delivery of an Order.
clauses.explanation_en: The company is not liable for any delays in delivering your order.
clauses.explanation_hi: Order delivery mein kisi bhi tarah ki deri ke liye company zimmedar nahi hogi.
